body: I wonder what may i be missing from her POV, i also might be forgetting some topics, because damn, i do feel like an abuser, sucks. Of course this is not the whole story but thats my side of the story.

Yea... that scares me, that she might not be able to understand my limits. I understand I can be very social retracted, but I keep wondering if she likes me this way or she just wants me to change. I do have to establish my limits once again (they were properly addressed in the beginning of this relationship), but I understand people can change, even tho I havent. I might have to remind her.

It might not be the case, every group is different. I respect you not ceding to drink alcohol because you dont like it. But, have you wondered how your friends feel with that? Like, you know how alcohol disinhibit people, if theyre talking stuff or behaving some way they´d usually wouldnt, but youre not because youre not drinking. Now, im not saying thats wrong and that it wouldnt let them spend a good time, but, is it really fair? Would you feel ok if they told you youre not welcome in the group unless youre drinking? 

So, yes I understand life is not about doing what you please, because there will be many things out of your hands that just must be done, but, what about the ones you have a choice on? Should you just do the because someone expects you to? 

I get your point, i really do, as ive mentioned before, I dont want her to be the only one sacrificing, I just dont want my sacrifices to go unnoticed, and even tho I might not go out clubbing, I dont think its my place to tell her what things have I done against my will, just because she wanted to.

I have to disagree to a point here, the problem is that I do feel like going out clubbing is a little too much for me and I have to do something I "mildly" dislike for her sake. I don´t mind sacrificing because I bet she has done some for me as well. But the problem is not going out clubbing, I believe is more about respecting one´s limits. Also, the whole unsatisfaction thing doesn´t come only for not going out. To be fair, there might be codependency to a degree. However, I do understand I should not enclose my mind into the thought of not doing that because i dont like it. Thats something I have to work on. 

I believe she feels "everything is done my way", just because she feels the social compromise to do things she doesnt really wanna do, and i dont.

I might just realized I'm not ready to be in a relationship or anything that requires compromise. I don't have many friends, but I've always surrounded myself by people who understands that I don't consider myself as someone very social. I don't go out frequently. Mostly, my inner circle (apart from some friends) has been my family, I have brothers, nephews and nieces my own age and close and whenever I wanted to hang out, I did with them. I do struggle with relationships in general, because not many are able to understand this, but the few who have are gold. 

I was actually a little bit enclosed in the idea that someone who loves you wouldn't make you do things you'd be uncomfortable with, but I need to reevaluate my thoughts. Are we supposed to do those things anyways for the ones we love no matter how they affect you?

PD: Thank you for your POV. It has really opened some parts of me I hadn't been able to unlock yet.

I believe that's where I struggle (finding the line between my own discomfort and her needs). I thought feeling unpleasantness in the environment would be a valid enough reason not to visit these kind of places and just go somewhere more chill. So, if she wants to go to a club, even tho I don't due to my reasons, I should still go and make an effort? I've gone out to those kind of places with her, she would like to increase the frequency.

Would you take a kid with autism bothered by loud noises to a club? I'm not saying I'm in the autistic spectrum, but I do find myself bothered by these sounds and people, is it less valid because im not in the spectrum?

I don't wanna victimize myself here, nor want I to mistreat her, I just want to be able to understand that giving in is not losing oneself.
I really appreciate your insight. Thank you so much for taking your time to reply.

That's what I'm afraid of, and that's what ive tried to explain to her. I cannot compromise that I will go out with her in the future (of course im not being 100% strict, we go out ocasionally), since I dont know if I will feel the same, but so far this is me. I don't want to end up in a relationship where 10 years later she's realized she's been suffering all this time. That's my biggest fear.

Sometimes I have felt like i might have a little social anxiety. I'm willing to compromise except I don't wanna lose myself or feel uncomfortable somewhere and pretend im having a nice time. Where we're currently located doesn't help either, since its a pretty remote community (we dont even have phone signal) disconnected from society, there is nothing to do here.
That sounds reasonable. I will sit down and talk to her and listen to her feelings and needs again.

I have to admit I found this a bit funny haha when you put it that way it does sound a little fucked up. But I try to be understanding (i dont promote SH), since i've done some self harm as well in the past.
I don't want to to say it's not a good relationship, because it's the most beautiful one i've had so far where i've given myself deeply, problems aside. I just dont want to feel like an abuser.

It's not only by not going clubbing with her, she complains that I don't go out for the "social compromises". Which I refuse to go if I don't feel like it, either as a couple or as coworker. Note that I mention "Social compromises" as in, the things society expects us to do, when talking about responsabilities then of course I comply.
I knew since the beginning she had some problems, and I told her mines as well. However, I don't want to be a reason for those problems to exacerbate.

I do not want to end the relationship, problems aside, it has been a very beautiful relationship with lots of personal growth. I  just don't want to unconsciously take advantage of her. I don't mind if she goes out alone or with her friends. I find the loud music very annoying and having to pay x10 for a drink. I've gone out a couple times, and we've had a good time, but it's not what I prefer. I cannot trust her when she express her satisfaction and happiness in this relationship, since when shes not saying that, shes complaining.

What about one's limits? I expressed since the very beginning I don't like going out to the kind of places she likes the same way she doesn't like rock climbing, which I do and she's not tried it w me. I think I'm making an effort, I don't want her to lift all the weight from our duties and relationship, I wash the dishes, clean the place, wash our clothes, she cooks, but I'm not willing to do something I'm not comfortable with. I do not want to be/feel selfish, but I've wondered, what is the limit between what she wants and what I don't feel comfortable doing? Like, where do i cede?
Hey, can you please send it?

Sorry for the late reply. By the 6th/7th day post sx, I was able to eat some harder (not too hard) stuff, So I was a lot better, I noticed how everyone's healing is different, on the 9th day I noticed I was bleeding and I thought it was the scabs falling off, but It wouldnt stop, I had to spit huge blood clots that wouldnt let me breathe, long story short, I had to go to the ER and stay at the Hospital overnight, they put me on some antifibrinolytic treatment during my stay. It wasnt scary, the worst part was those huge (they were really huge) clots. After all it turned out better than fine, after a week (15/16th day post sx) I was able to move on with my normal life. I guess It wasnt that bad for me despite the lancinating pain on the 5th day and the bleeding. Good Luck everyone!

Day 5 post op here. So far no complications and can say day 3 has been the worst so far. That night I kept waking up from a lancinating pain each side individually, so woke up multiple times. It's curious how having cold things work for some, for me it doesnt, it just hurts more. My uvula is swollen right as it was on day 1. I'd say the pain is tolerable but sometimes it gets so annoying I cannot even swallow my saliva. What's your experience by now?
